triggerLabelMany.zh: 子代理模型，已选 {count} 个

hint.zh: 选一条时后续子代理都用它；选多条时由会话模型按任务挑一条。
hint.en: One route sends every later subagent through it; with several, the session model picks one for the task at hand.

hintOne.zh: 后续子代理都用这一条。再选一条可以变成按任务挑选。
hintOne.en: Every later subagent uses this route. Picking another one switches to choosing per task.

clearDesc.zh: 回到插件开关与官方策略本来的行为。
clearDesc.en: Go back to what the plugin switch and the official policy did on their own.

saveFailed.zh: 没有保存成功，仍按上一次保存的选择执行。
saveFailed.en: The save did not go through; the last saved selection still applies.

full.en: The list already holds the {max} routes it takes.

reasonNoPolicy.zh: 官方「允许 Agent 为子智能体选择模型」在这条会话创建时没有开启，因此这条会话没有可选的子代理模型。
reasonNoPolicy.en: The official switch that lets an agent choose a subagent model was off when this session was created, so the session has no subagent route to pick.

reasonNoSession.zh: 会话还没有打开，暂时读不到它的子代理模型。
reasonNoSession.en: The session is not open yet, so its subagent routes cannot be read.

reasonStore.zh: 子代理模型的选择没能读出来，重新打开页面后再试。
reasonStore.en: The saved subagent routes could not be read; reopen the page and try again.

reasonStale.zh: 已保存的选择里有这条会话不再允许的路由，请改选或清除。
reasonStale.en: The saved selection names routes this session no longer allows; pick again or clear it.

pickerDesc.zh: 在输入框右侧加一个入口，为当前会话选一条或多条子代理模型路由。
pickerDesc.en: Adds an entry beside the composer for picking the subagent routes the current session delegates on.
